pages.title: Work by Hand
pages.text: Firstworks machines are deliberately physical. Load the material, read the station's state, then perform the required action. JEI shows recipes; Jade and contextual hints explain what the station expects right now.

pages.title: Safe Interruptions
pages.text: Partial workstation progress is saved. If a process pauses, cools, or the world reloads, retrieve the input only when you intend to reset that work. Output is collected separately once a batch completes.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Inventory insertion and output extraction may be automated where exposed, but manual work is still manual. Loom shuttle/shed controls, mortar grinding, and forge actions must be operated through their real interaction points.
